aquagrid.meta_desc: AquaGrid: hurricane protection for openings larger than 3.8 m. For hotels, lobbies and unique facades on Mexico's coastline.
aquagrid.hero_body: AquaGrid is the only protection system for large openings where conventional panels don't work — neither engineering nor logistically.
aquagrid.prob_title: WHEN THE STANDARD SYSTEM CANNOT BE INSTALLED.
aquagrid.prob_body:
Conventional panel systems have an engineering limit: they cannot span openings larger than 3.8 meters between anchor points without compromising structural integrity.

There are companies that install their systems over 20-meter openings when their own engineering says they'll fail at 3. We refuse to do that.

AquaGrid was developed by Hurricane Solution to solve what the market ignored: double-height hotel lobbies, large-format glass facades, curved openings, auto dealerships and any space where conventional engineering falls short.
aquagrid.ben_title: THREE REASONS WHY THERE IS NO ALTERNATIVE.
aquagrid.ben1_body: Protects openings of more than 20 meters between anchor points. Where any other system would fail or cannot be installed, AquaGrid works.
aquagrid.ben2_body: 7,800 lbs of tensile strength. 50% open weave that allows half the load to pass through, drastically reducing forces on the structure and anchors.
aquagrid.ben3_body: We developed AquaGrid because we refused to install systems beyond their engineering limits. If your opening exceeds what the standard system can protect, AquaGrid is the answer — not improvisation.
aquagrid.gallery_body: Real AquaGrid system installations — from complete facades to large lobbies, regardless of scale.

aquagrid.seg2_body: Double-height facades, panoramic openings and large-format entrances. Where HS-1500 cannot cover the distance, AquaGrid solves it.
aquagrid.seg3_body: Essential facilities that cannot stop operating. AquaGrid was designed with the same spirit as military installations — to hold when it's needed most.

aquagrid.cta_body: Tell us the challenge. If there's a solution, we'll find it.

faq.meta_desc: Answers to frequently asked questions about our hurricane protection systems: certifications, installation, deployment times and warranty.
faq.hero_body: Everything you need to know about hurricane protection in Mexico.
faq.q1: WHAT SETS HURRICANE SOLUTION APART FROM OTHER COMPANIES IN MEXICO?
faq.a1: We are the only company in Mexico with military Level E certification — the only one that tests all 4 hurricane forces simultaneously. We are also the only member of the International Hurricane Protection Association outside the United States, and our anchor system is the only patented one in Mexico. We have been operating since 2008 with zero failures in correctly executed installations.
faq.q2: WHAT IS LEVEL E CERTIFICATION AND WHY DOES IT MATTER?
faq.a2: Level E is a certification developed by the United States military to protect essential facilities. It is the only certification that tests wind, rain, projectiles and barometric pressure change simultaneously. Other certifications test them separately. We are the only ones in Mexico with this certification.
faq.q3: WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN HS-1500, HS-1250 AND HS-875?
faq.a3: The HS-1500 is our flagship — ballistic fabric with Level E certification, over 1,500 psi and a 10-year warranty. The HS-1250 is Cat 5 certified, available in white, 7-year warranty — ideal when aesthetics are a priority. The HS-875 is more accessible, certified up to Cat 3, 5-year warranty — suitable for residences farther from the coast.
faq.q4: WHAT IS AQUAGRID AND WHEN DO I NEED IT?
faq.a4: AquaGrid is a high-resistance mesh system for openings that conventional systems cannot cover. Standard systems have a limit of 3.8 meters — AquaGrid can cover more than 20 meters. Ideal for hotel lobbies, auto showrooms, hospitals and any space with large openings.
faq.q5: HOW QUICKLY CAN IT BE DEPLOYED BEFORE A STORM?
faq.a5: For a large hotel, one employee per room can protect their space in 3 to 5 minutes. For a residence, full deployment typically takes 1 to 3 hours with 2 people. We train your staff and leave a written manual.
faq.q6: DO THE SYSTEMS HELP REDUCE INSURANCE COSTS?
faq.a6: Yes. Insurers such as Chubb, AIG and Mapfre recognize HS-1500 systems as a certified mitigation measure. We provide the necessary documentation to present to your insurer.
faq.q7: HOW LONG DOES THE SYSTEM LAST AND WHAT MAINTENANCE DOES IT REQUIRE?
faq.a7: The service life is 15 to 20 years. Maintenance is minimal: occasional washing with soap and water. Resistant to UV, mold and salinity — designed for coastal climate.
